Quiet capital, loud results

Nathan Teatim runs Mcxonic Enterprises and CxO Records, and is the creator of Maguitar Mcxonic.

His books look at money and prices through lessons learned from the coast of Mombasa to the opportunities of Nairobi. His main idea is that freedom comes from margin, skills, relationships and protecting what you build.

True wealth is not about having more. It is about needing less to feel free.
